source_evidence: Move intact annotated header_check/header_write blocks to src/header_io.cpp and my_srand/rnd to src/crt_random.cpp. Their public headers own the same current ABI; General reexports them rather than keeping duplicate prototypes. Existing LPSTR/LPCSTR and uint32_t mean char*/const char* and unsigned int. Original marker/prototype disagreements remain preserved seed evidence, not silently reinterpreted signatures.

Keep original signed-char fgetc/fputc behavior, EOF narrowing and unconditional extra read, NUL and 0x1A output, one seed call after logging, unused second rnd pointer and native INT_MIN subtraction-wrap branch. No new safety behavior or modern CRT-provider claim. The sole admitted status-prose cleanup removes the obsolete DLL-redirection instruction; exact inverse tests restore just that sentence for historical comparison.

Add two sources with measured source-local frame contexts while General and all other application/link/measurement policies remain unchanged. Both new owners and residual General have controlled native whole-object counterparts. Preserve the immutable b24 task baseline, all original identities/claims/lessons and existing pending cross-owner findings. This source-ownership decision is a coordinator-reviewed manual checkpoint, not automatic change or full-project acceptance.
